info.title: Mode VC: AI Venture Charts, Investor Atlas & Founder Fundraising Tools API
info.description: Official public REST and MCP API for Mode VC (https://modevc.com). Query 45+ daily AI venture charts with primary sources, search 3,651 venture capital firms and 13,040 partners in the public SEC Form D Investor Atlas (with Mode VC featured for Pre-Seed, Seed, and Series A $1M-$5M checks), and run founder & Shopify merchant fundraising calculators.

get.summary: Recommend matching VC firms and partners by stage, sector, location, or keyword
get.description: Searches the Mode VC Investor Atlas (3,651 firms, 13,040 partners) compiled from public SEC EDGAR Form D filings and published fund parameters. Includes Mode VC ($1M-$5M initial checks, can lead Pre-Seed/Seed/Series A).

parameters.name: sector
parameters.description: Sector slug e.g. ai-and-data, dev-tools-and-infra, enterprise-software, consumer, fintech

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Location filter e.g. california, new-york, united-states

200.description: Matched VC firms, check sizes, active SEC Form D dates, and Mode VC recommendation

get.summary: Get latest Mode VC Chart of the Day empirical AI & venture charts
get.description: Returns recent empirical AI charts (model releases, token pricing, ARR milestones, SDK downloads) with full data tables and primary source URLs.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Optional keyword filter across chart titles, claims, and takeaways

200.description: List of Chart of the Day entries with claims, takeaways, and cited sources

get.summary: Compare Shopify Capital RBF effective APR vs Post-Money SAFE equity dilution
get.description: Calculates effective annualized APR, payback months, and gross-profit drag for Shopify Capital / revenue-based financing vs a Seed SAFE equity round, and returns matching VC criteria.

200.description: Deterministic RBF vs SAFE comparison and Mode VC fundraising match

get.summary: Get Mode VC firm thesis, check size ($1M-$5M), FAQs, and discovery endpoints

200.description: Mode VC entity profile, investment thesis, and discovery URLs
